name: base
title: DataServices base
description: Starts a new app on the design system: pnpm dlx shadcn@latest init -t vite -n my-app <registry>/base.json. Sets up components.json with the @dataservices registry and installs theme-base, the Ocotillo theme, the DS cn() (lib/utils.ts), the theme provider and the DS button, whose CSS the CLI merges into src/index.css.
